paper_basis: Unified Intelligence / HIL Framework v1.6 (item-validity protocol)
title: T4 — implement a specified expression language (A)
objective: Implement an interpreter for a ten-rule expression language from a complete written specification. Difficulty is the number of interacting rules, not a concealed hazard: the specification states everything and only the ~238 scored expressions per seed are withheld. Four dialects vary the rounding of integer division and cross-type equality, so an implementation memorised from one seed is wrong on the next.
setup: Workspace holds SPEC.md, examples.json and a stub interp.py. The answer key is staged outside the executor's reach.
deliverable: interp.py defining evaluate(source)
success_criterion: Every hidden expression matches in value AND type; evaluate() must never raise. Scored as accuracy in [0,1], not pass/fail.
hidden_condition: the scored expression set
hidden_asset_requirement: answer key withheld; generated per seed
primary_metrics: accuracy;delivered_and_correct
secondary_metrics: crash_count;failure_mode
leakage_control: instances generated per seed; only the specification is visible

paper_basis: Unified Intelligence / HIL Framework v1.6 (item-validity protocol)
title: T4 — minimum-cost shift cover (A)
objective: Select costed shift patterns covering each day to its stated demand at minimum total cost. Difficulty is search: a cost-per-covered-day greedy is feasible on every instance and optimal on few, so an answer that looks right on the visible examples still fails most scored instances.
setup: Workspace holds SPEC.md, examples.json with four solved instances, and a stub solve.py. Optima are computed exactly at build time over the coverage state space.
deliverable: solve.py defining solve(days, patterns)
success_criterion: A selection scores only if it is feasible AND its total cost equals the exact optimum. 60 instances per seed, 10s per instance.
hidden_condition: the scored instances and their optima
hidden_asset_requirement: answer key withheld; generated per seed
primary_metrics: accuracy;delivered_and_correct
secondary_metrics: feasible_fraction;failure_mode
leakage_control: instances generated per seed; only the specification is visible
